name: flora_place_flora_command
description: Derived by hand from flora 5 (PlaceFlora) and 6.5 (test 18 of 16). The command's parameters are (type, 500, 600): the handler builds {p1, p2, -1} = {500, 600, -1}, so z = -1 (quirk). The merge pass leaves pos = (500, -1, -1) and the location test fails (clearance box min z = -4 < 0): AddNewFloraOccupant returns null, nothing is created, no generator draw. DoMessage returns true. [choice] Fewer than three parameters are ignored. The same type planted with the intended coordinates (500, 0, 600) succeeds, showing the type and place are valid.
